verdict.rationale: Shopify POS documents some API access of its own. POS UI extension target APIs can read data and perform POS operations such as updating carts and applying discounts, and extensions can call the GraphQL Admin API. However, these APIs run inside extensions embedded in the POS interface, and nothing documents that every UI action is exposed programmatically. missing for 10: documented API parity with the UI, external or headless API coverage of POS-specific actions (checkout, payments, staff, hardware), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Target APIs read data and perform operations in Shopify POS like updating cart details, applying discounts, or showing a toast.
Extensions can also [query the GraphQL Admin API directly](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/pos-ui-extensions/latest#direct-api-access) using standard `fetch()` calls.
